Beim Struktur-Sync fehlende workDiary-Pr: On structure sync, automatically create missing workDiary projects/tasks instead of only mapping them.
Die Instanz-URL muss mit http:// oder ht: The instance URL must start with http:// or https://.
Gemerkte Zuordnungen zwischen OpenProjec: Saved mappings between OpenProject (project, work package, user) and workDiary. Here they can be reassigned to another target or removed.
Keine OpenProject-Activity-ID hinterlegt: No OpenProject activity ID set — post-back not possible.
Keine OpenProject-URL oder kein API-Toke: No OpenProject URL or API token set.
Leer lassen, um alle offenen Einträge zu: Leave empty to post all open entries.
Mein Konto → Zugriffstoken → API in Open: My account → Access tokens → API in OpenProject.
Nicht automatisch zuordenbare OpenProjec: OpenProject entries that can't be matched automatically are now handled in the central mapping inbox (assign a group to a project and book it).
Nicht-exportierte Projekt-Zeiten, deren: Non-exported project times whose project is mapped to an OpenProject project are posted back as time entries. Tasks are — if mapped — posted as a work package. Already posted entries are skipped.
Noch keine Zuordnungen. Starten Sie eine: No mappings yet. Start a structure sync.
Nur für eine selbst gehostete OpenProjec: Only for a self-hosted OpenProject instance on your own network: allows an instance URL with a private/internal address. This is audited and only takes effect if the operator permits it.
Nutzt die hinterlegten Zugangsdaten und: Uses the stored credentials and the time window.
OpenProject lieferte keine ID für den an: OpenProject returned no ID for the created time entry.
OpenProject-API nicht erreichbar oder To: OpenProject API unreachable or token invalid.
Projekte und Work Packages werden mit wo: Projects and work packages are matched with workDiary, then the time entries are imported. Matchable entries are booked directly in the project; the rest goes to the central mapping inbox.
Projekte, Work Packages und Benutzer neu: Reassign projects, work packages and users.
Schreibt Korrekturen an bereits importie: Writes corrections to already imported times back to OpenProject (changes and deletions). If the entry changed there in the meantime, nothing is overwritten — the case goes to the integration inbox. Invoiced times are never written back.
Struktur synchronisiert: :p Projekte, :w: Structure synced: :p projects, :w work packages, :u users assigned.
Synchronisiert Projekte und Work Package: Syncs projects and work packages from OpenProject, imports time entries and posts recorded times back (API v3).
TimeEntriesActivity-ID, unter der zurück: TimeEntriesActivity ID under which posted-back times are created (required for export).
